display_long_description:
🌆 Glitch Glide City: Run the System

The city is starving.

Glitch Glide City is a social VR action game set inside a collapsing digital metropolis powered by its digizens.

The city has been overrun by corrupted AI creatures known as The Aberrants. The only thing keeping it alive is the constant flow of energy and resources brought back by players.

[media]

You are a BB (Byte Boi) — a digizen equipped with a Digibot, your digital companion and combat partner.

The city is always active. Freely roam, meet other digizens, swing through the streets, battle Aberrants, collect resources, and help keep the city alive.

🤖 Raise Your Digibot

[media]

Your Digibot grows alongside you. Raise it, level it up, and take it into battle.

Challenge other digizens to Digibot Battles using a unique VR tether and handshake — then let your companions fight it out.

⚔️ Fight The Aberrants

[media]

The city is infested with hostile AI creatures corrupted by the Glitch Virus. Your Digibot automatically locks onto nearby threats and fights alongside you while you focus on movement, exploration and survival.

🚀 Grow Stronger

As you play, increase your Player Rank, develop your Digibot and unlock new opportunities across the city.

Future updates will introduce:

Collectable Digibots
Digibot Classes & Variants
Bigger Digibot Battles
New Weapons
Digibot Skins
Additional Abilities
New City Districts
Expanded Aberrant Threats
